description: BFWS-f5 is BFWS with a finer novelty measure: it keeps one novelty table for each pair of goal count `#g` and relaxed-plan count `#r`. A *relaxed plan* is a plan for the task with all delete effects removed; with the `sas-plus` adapter it comes from the best supporters of h^add. `#r` counts how many facts of the current relaxed plan the path to a state has made true, and the relaxed plan is computed again at each state where `#g` drops. The open list is still ordered by `⟨w, #g⟩`. Like BFWS, it is complete on finite state spaces but not optimal, and the `#r` guidance can save many expansions on planning tasks.

papers.title: Best-First Width Search: Exploration and Exploitation in Classical Planning
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
